== English Reflections III comparison ==
Both player bands of the Dark printing use “hit here” and placement in the owner’s Used Pile. The 27 January 2003 supplement directs readers to use “instead placed” and retains the “hit” wording. The July 2007 rulebook and January 2013 slip preserve that text. The 2012 rulebook specifies placement when the character is about to be hit. June 2017 printed that state. The ability threshold, attached cards and Used Pile destination remain.
